findings.summary: validate="many_to_one" raises MergeError on duplicate customer_id rows in customers, crashing the report instead of degrading gracefully, and the docstring doesn't mention this.
count on order_id skips null IDs, so those orders add to revenue but not to the orders count if order_id can be null.
pandas matches NaN keys in a merge, so orders with null customer_id take the region of a customers row with null customer_id instead of falling into "unknown".
sort_values isn't stable by default, so regions with equal revenue may be ordered non-deterministically; use kind="stable" or a secondary sort key.
